understand.note: Understanding-first rollout (father approved 17 Nov 2026). wave1: friend's-mistake items (q.friend), predict-before-computing (q.predict), situation-changing twins come back first. wave2: explain step = pick the right reason (q.check) after right AND wrong answers + one-line own reason on one lesson question.

minDay.note: Minimum day: she picks it on the home day panel; a 6-8 question set counts as a full day (flame, map piece). Shown to the father on the parent page.

checkpointsNote: Approved 17 Nov 2026. short = our own unseen timed mixed set (content/sets kind 'checkpoint', ~24 items, topics taught >= 7 days earlier) in place of the lesson; full = a recalled paper printed at home, 90 min, father enters the score on the parent page. Decision on tutoring ~8-10 Feb 2027.
gateNote: Acquisition gate (father agreed A+B 22 Nov; queue 2 built 23 Nov): a new lesson with >= minL1 level-1 items serves level 1 first until need of the last win are right (at least min, at most cap), then l2 level-2 items (l2fail if the gate was not met); the other level-2 and every level-3 item are carried to later lesson days as warm-up, up to carry a day, for carryDays. Lessons with fewer level-1 items run as before.

december.note: December focus (father 24 Nov): from 'from' one job per mission (lesson warm-up = own warm items only; carried items = own mission; loop checks in the mistake review; spaced/checkpoint items in the sweep). From 'from' to 'to' the sweep has a fixed size (school sweepSchool, holiday the level's base) and draws unseen items of midterm subtopics taught >= minAge days ago. Switched on 24 Nov (father: she only uses the app in the evening, so the same day is safe). 24 Nov night (father: 'too many items today', ~87 active min on a school day vs 45-60): school days sweepSchool 6->5, carrySchool 4 (was 6 = gate.carry), reviewSchool 4 (+1 loop check; was 6). Holidays unchanged.
